extracted.name: Pumpkin Bread
extracted.description: Not too sweet, just enough spice to be tasty. Perfect seasonal snack. #GlobalApron 2024
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350*. Line loaf pan with parchment paper.
Sift dry ingredients together; set aside.
Whisk together: eggs, purée, sugar, oil and vanilla. Slowly add dry ingredients, whisking until well blended.
Pour into prepared loaf pan. Bake until toothpick inserted comes out clean. 45-50 minutes.
Keep in airtight container, store in refrigerator up to 5 days. To freeze: tightly wrap in aluminum foil, then place in freezer safe ziplock bag. Keep up to 3 months.
